name: dag-dependency-graph-execution
explain: A DAG workflow engine represents execution dependencies, runs independent fan-out branches concurrently within semaphore bounds, and detects cycles.
steps: Declare node dependencies and validate graph acyclicity using Kahn's algorithm. || Execute independent fan-out steps concurrently using asynchronous event barriers. || Bound parallel task execution using an asyncio Semaphore to protect downstream resources.
expect: DAG workflow dependency engine and parallel execution verified successfully.

name: fan-in-partial-failure-reducer
explain: Fan-in branch reducers join parallel executions, differentiating critical required branches from supplementary optional branches with graceful degradation.
steps: Classify branches as critical or optional in the fan-in join barrier. || Return degraded PARTIAL_SUCCESS outcomes when optional branches fail while failing fast on critical errors. || Format synthesis prompts with explicit failure provenance to prevent model hallucination.
expect: Fan-in partial failure reduction and error provenance verified successfully.

name: durable-orchestration-state-checkpoint
explain: Durable workflows persist step checkpoints and execution cursors, resuming directly from crash points without re-executing completed operations.
steps: Persist completed step outputs and workflow cursors atomically after each node. || Simulate process crashes during workflow execution. || Resume directly from the last valid checkpoint without repeating completed side effects.
expect: Durable workflow checkpointing and crash resumption verified successfully.

name: coordinated-retries-circuit-breaker
explain: Coordinated retry policies apply exponential backoff with jitter to transient faults, trip circuit breakers on consecutive outages, and enforce global retry budgets.
steps: Distinguish transient connection errors from deterministic validation faults. || Apply exponential backoff with jitter while preserving idempotency keys across attempts. || Trip step-level circuit breakers to prevent thundering herd load spikes on dead services.
expect: Coordinated retries, circuit breakers, and cost explosion defenses verified successfully.

name: human-in-the-loop-pause-resume
explain: Workflows suspend execution at decision gates, minting cryptographic approval tokens and re-verifying target resource revisions before resuming.
steps: Transition workflows to SUSPENDED_WAITING_APPROVAL at high-impact mutation gates. || Mint HMAC-signed approval tokens binding parameters, target revision, and expiration. || Re-verify reviewer roles and check that target resources were not modified during the waiting period.
expect: Human-in-the-loop workflow suspension and cryptographic resumption verified successfully.

name: shared-blackboard-evaluator
explain: The Shared Blackboard pattern coordinates multi-agent memory partitions, while orchestration evaluators measure completion rates, step efficiency, and costs.
steps: Partition shared memory into problem, hypotheses, evidence, and synthesis sections with revision tracking. || Post and read multi-agent contributions without direct point-to-point agent coupling. || Calculate workflow completion rates, step efficiency percentages, and cost per successful run.
expect: Shared Blackboard memory pattern and orchestration evaluation verified successfully.
